hashing.canonical: SHA-256 of the file bytes, with every CRLF replaced by LF except in the declared Native executables, after rewriting the channel wrappers (SKILL.md, agents/openai.yaml, the install/setup guides and the detector scripts) to the production identity; identical in the test and the production package of one release and in any Git checkout of them. Used by promotion.
hashing.shipped: SHA-256 of the file bytes exactly as published in this package, with every CRLF replaced by LF except in the declared Native executables (assets/native/<platform>/dsphere-native-agent[.exe]), which are hashed as they are. Used to verify an installed copy.
